issues.description: Visibility mismatch for the Book.title property: the problem statement (part 1.2) specifies a Book with a title and author (title must be readable by the client), and the solution's Client implementation accesses book.title (Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift). However, the reference implementation declares the title field as private (private let title: String) in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift, which prevents external access and would cause the Client's access to book.title to fail to compile. This contradicts the problem statement and blocks the client's printing of book titles.
issues.suggestedFix: Make Book.title accessible to the Client. Replace the private declaration with a module-accessible immutable property (e.g. change 'private let title: String' to 'let title: String') so Client can read book.title when printing the inventory while preserving immutability.
